card.title: No Trouble at All
card.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course your brother can stay for dinner. I'll give him my pie.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please don't worry. There are peas, and I had a substantial breakfast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll order you a pizza. It takes forty minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How thoughtful. I'll keep everyone company while they eat, then you can all watch me have dinner at nine.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 graciously gives away pie, A3 minimizes hunger while naming breakfast and A5 accepts pizza by displaying the long lonely delay.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 A not eaten causes A3 peas fallback; B4 forty-minute pizza causes A5 narrated sequence of watching others then being watched.

relationship.evidence: B2 notices the sacrifice and B4 offers a real replacement meal.

heightening.evidence: B4 helpful solution still costs time, which A5 makes impossible to overlook without refusing it.

specificity.evidence: A1 extra dinner guest and B2 A's hunger establish the concrete inconvenience.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 everyone watching dinner at nine turns B4 delivery delay into a graciously phrased social cost.
